spec_case: issue #503 (native Ollama, 404 model-not-found is not retried)
description: A 404 {"error": "model ... not found"} body with retries configured: exit 22 with a 404 status is never retryable, so only one request is recorded despite max_attempts: 3, and meta.error carries the exact 'Try `ollama pull m` first.' hint.
